newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money market rates steady as SNB meets.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money market rates steady as SNB meets.

text.p: Swiss money market rates were little changed on Thursday.
One bank quoted tomorrow/next money at 1-5/16, to roughly 1-3/8 and said overall acitivity was quiet.
The Swiss National Bank's (SNB) policy-setting board holds a regular weekly meeting today. The SNB will, as usual, give the results of the meeting at 1200 GMT.
Traders said the market currently has adequate liquidity, even though the SNB was not seen adding either through swaps or other money market instruments this morning
Activity was quiet before the end of the SNB meeting, but traders expected no change to its discount rate, currently at 1.50 percent.
"Everybody is waiting for SNB this afternoon. I don't think they will do anything, they won't take the rates down," one trader said.
He added that the discount rate in Switzerland is largely symbolic anyway. Money market rates in recent sessions have dipped below the discount rate.
"They will wait to see what the Bundesbank does next week," the trader added.
The Bundesbank's next regular policy-setting meeting will be held next Thursday.
